welcome.title: Hand recorder
welcome.text: Follow the steps on this panel. Each one plays a short clip of what to do: copy it. In the clips the palm is light and the back of the hand is dark.|The button on the right side of the headset goes on when a step waits for you, and pauses while recording.

done.title: All done
done.text: Thank you! You can take off the headset.|Review your recordings in the Hand recorder window.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.text: What was recorded so far is saved. Review it in the Hand recorder window.

sections.title: Hand size
sections.intro: First, your hand size. Copy the clip: both hands about 40 cm out, still, about 1 s for each shape.

prompts.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Palms toward you, then backs toward you|Fingers spread, then a fist, then point|About 1 s for each shape

sections.title: Index taps
sections.intro: Thumb to index fingertip taps: light and lazy, about 2 a second, the way you'd click.

prompts.text: Left hand only, the right one down and out of view.|One hand low and relaxed, other fingers loosely curled: look down at it|2 light taps palm down|2 taps edge-on, 2 palm up, 2 palm toward your face
Right hand only, the left one down and out of view.|One hand low and relaxed, other fingers loosely curled: look down at it|2 light taps palm down|2 taps edge-on, 2 palm up, 2 palm toward your face
Now both hands at once, each doing the same.|One hand low and relaxed, other fingers loosely curled: look down at it|2 light taps palm down|2 taps edge-on, 2 palm up, 2 palm toward your face

Left hand only, the right one down and out of view.|Keep tapping while you move: centre at chest height|Far out to your side, then crossed past the middle|Close to your face, then at arm's length|Quick taps, a double tap, one slow press

Right hand only, the left one down and out of view.|Keep tapping while you move: centre at chest height|Far out to your side, then crossed past the middle|Close to your face, then at arm's length|Quick taps, a double tap, one slow press

Now both hands at once, each doing the same.|Keep tapping while you move: centre at chest height|Far out to your side, then crossed past the middle|Close to your face, then at arm's length|Quick taps, a double tap, one slow press
Both hands tapping|Then one hand over the other, still tapping

sections.title: Middle taps
sections.intro: Now the thumb meets the middle finger's pad. Keep the index half-curled, out of the way.

prompts.text: Left hand only, the right one down and out of view.|Thumb to the middle finger's pad, index half-curled: look down at the hand|2 taps palm down, edge-on, palm up, toward your face|Then a few taps out to the side and close to your face

Right hand only, the left one down and out of view.|Thumb to the middle finger's pad, index half-curled: look down at the hand|2 taps palm down, edge-on, palm up, toward your face|Then a few taps out to the side and close to your face

Now both hands at once, each doing the same.|Thumb to the middle finger's pad, index half-curled: look down at the hand|2 taps palm down, edge-on, palm up, toward your face|Then a few taps out to the side and close to your face
Left hand only, the right one down and out of view.|3 slow, firm presses|Keep tapping and turn your head until the hand reaches the edge of the view|Then turn the other way
Right hand only, the left one down and out of view.|3 slow, firm presses|Keep tapping and turn your head until the hand reaches the edge of the view|Then turn the other way
Now both hands at once, each doing the same.|3 slow, firm presses|Keep tapping and turn your head until the hand reaches the edge of the view|Then turn the other way

sections.title: Look-alikes
sections.intro: Things that look like taps but aren't: near misses, rubbing, other fingers, fists. None of them should touch thumb to index.

prompts.text: Left hand only, the right one down and out of view.|Stop 1 cm short of a tap|Rub the thumb along the side of the index|Ring finger to thumb|Let a loosely curled hand rest
Right hand only, the left one down and out of view.|Stop 1 cm short of a tap|Rub the thumb along the side of the index|Ring finger to thumb|Let a loosely curled hand rest
Now both hands at once, each doing the same.|Stop 1 cm short of a tap|Rub the thumb along the side of the index|Ring finger to thumb|Let a loosely curled hand rest
Left hand only, the right one down and out of view.|Close a fist slowly, open it|Close it fast, open it|Once at chest height, once low
Right hand only, the left one down and out of view.|Close a fist slowly, open it|Close it fast, open it|Once at chest height, once low
Now both hands at once, each doing the same.|Close a fist slowly, open it|Close it fast, open it|Once at chest height, once low

sections.title: Hold and drag
sections.intro: Pinch and hold, then move while holding, as if dragging a window.

prompts.text: Left hand only, the right one down and out of view.|Pinch and hold 3 s|Drag up, down, left, right|Roll the wrist while holding|Loosen the other fingers without letting go
Right hand only, the left one down and out of view.|Pinch and hold 3 s|Drag up, down, left, right|Roll the wrist while holding|Loosen the other fingers without letting go
Now both hands at once, each doing the same.|Pinch and hold 3 s|Drag up, down, left, right|Roll the wrist while holding|Loosen the other fingers without letting go
One hand holds a pinch, the other taps|Hands apart, then close, then crossed

sections.title: Three-finger scroll
sections.intro: Thumb on the index and middle fingertips together, held while the hand moves.

prompts.text: Left hand only, the right one down and out of view.|Thumb on the index and middle tips|Move up and down slowly, then fast|Let the ring finger join once
Right hand only, the left one down and out of view.|Thumb on the index and middle tips|Move up and down slowly, then fast|Let the ring finger join once
Now both hands at once, each doing the same.|Thumb on the index and middle tips|Move up and down slowly, then fast|Let the ring finger join once

sections.title: Palm up
sections.intro: Palms up. This is where tracking gets lost today, so take your time: the fingertips drop toward the floor, then rise toward you.

prompts.text: Arms forward, palms up, fingers flat: hands close (elbows tucked)|Fingertips drop toward the floor and back: 1 slow, 2 fast|Same with forearms half out, then arms straight|One drop low at the waist, one at eye height
Palms up at the same three distances|Fingertips curl up toward you and back: 1 slow, 2 fast each
Left hand only, the right one down and out of view.|Palm up, hold a pinch|Drop the fingertips and raise them, still pinching|Flip palm up and down with the wrist bent
Right hand only, the left one down and out of view.|Palm up, hold a pinch|Drop the fingertips and raise them, still pinching|Flip palm up and down with the wrist bent
Now both hands at once, each doing the same.|Palm up, hold a pinch|Drop the fingertips and raise them, still pinching|Flip palm up and down with the wrist bent

sections.title: Strokes and gestures
sections.intro: Quick strokes, a wave, and talking with your hands.

prompts.text: Left hand only, the right one down and out of view.|Lazy susan stroke each way, with the return stroke|A wave|5 s of talking with your hands
Right hand only, the left one down and out of view.|Lazy susan stroke each way, with the return stroke|A wave|5 s of talking with your hands
Now both hands at once, each doing the same.|Lazy susan stroke each way, with the return stroke|A wave|5 s of talking with your hands

sections.title: Reach and pull
sections.intro: Reaching out: grab something far away and pull it in, push and flick away, then a real object. Have a cup or your phone in reach.

prompts.text: Left hand only, the right one down and out of view.|Open palm at a far target|Close to a fist and pull back
Right hand only, the left one down and out of view.|Open palm at a far target|Close to a fist and pull back
Now both hands at once, each doing the same.|Open palm at a far target|Close to a fist and pull back
Left hand only, the right one down and out of view.|Push away, then flick away|Reach for a cup or your phone
Right hand only, the left one down and out of view.|Push away, then flick away|Reach for a cup or your phone
Now both hands at once, each doing the same.|Push away, then flick away|Reach for a cup or your phone

sections.title: Fists
sections.intro: Two fists, as if holding a big screen by its edges.

prompts.text: Two fists: hold, pull apart, push together|Fists with the palms in, down, then up

sections.title: Edges and exits
sections.intro: Hands leaving the view and coming back. Keep your head still and go slowly near the edges.

prompts.text: Right hand open: slide out past the right edge until gone, wait 1 s, back|Same up past your face|Left hand pinching: out past the left edge, then down past your lap
Both hands cross fully to the opposite sides|Hold a moment, come back

sections.title: Desk work
sections.intro: Now your desk. Look down at your hands while you work.

prompts.text: Type a few words, use the mouse, pick up the phone|One tap, then back to the keys
No keyboard: rest your hands on the desk and pretend.|Type a few words, use the mouse, pick up the phone|One tap, then back to the keys

sections.title: Controllers
sections.intro: Put both controllers on the desk in front of you, in view.

prompts.text: Pick up the controllers, set them down|A tap in between

sections.title: No hands
sections.intro: Last one: put your hands down, out of view.

prompts.text: Keep your hands out of view and look slowly around the room.
